turns.speaker: Sam Rivera
turns.text: Hey, how's the week going? Anything on fire?

turns.speaker: Dev Patel
turns.text: Not on fire. I'll be honest though, finding old research is still painful. I searched the repository for the checkout interviews and got forty results, none of them tagged.

turns.speaker: Sam Rivera
turns.text: Yeah, that keeps coming up. Did the tagging work go anywhere?

turns.speaker: Dev Patel
turns.text: Hannah started a taxonomy, but nobody's applied it to past studies yet. Half our insights live in slide decks nobody can search.

turns.speaker: Speaker 3
turns.text: Sorry, wrong room, I thought this was the crit.

turns.speaker: Sam Rivera
turns.text: No worries. Dev, I'll be out Thursday, so let's sort this now.

turns.speaker: Dev Patel
turns.text: Okay. I'll pull the last six months of study notes into one folder by Friday so we can tag them in one go.

turns.speaker: Sam Rivera
turns.text: Great. Let me ask Hannah whether her taxonomy draft is ready to apply to those studies.

turns.speaker: Dev Patel
turns.text: Sounds good. Separately, the crit started late again on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Sam Rivera
turns.text: Noted, that's for Marcus. Thanks, Dev.
